cues.text: Welcome to sweet spot, three times ten minutes. We start with ten minutes of warm-up, building gently from easy to steady. Keep your cadence smooth and your shoulders relaxed.
Halfway through the warm-up. Let the legs open up. The power keeps rising a little from here.
Thirty seconds until the first effort. Pick a comfortable gear and get ready.
First effort. Ten minutes at sweet spot, eighty-eight percent of your threshold. It should feel strong but controlled, about seven out of ten. You can still talk in short sentences.
Halfway through the first block. Breathe deep and steady, and keep the pedals turning round.
One minute left. Hold it right there.
Well done. Five minutes easy now. Spin light, have a drink, and let your heart rate come down.
Thirty seconds to the second effort.
Effort two of three. Same target, ten minutes. Settle in early and don't chase the numbers in the first minute.
Five minutes done, five to go. Stay smooth and stay seated.
Last minute of block two. You're two thirds of the way there.
Good work. Easy spinning for five minutes. One more block to come.
Thirty seconds. The last effort is coming up.
Final effort. Ten minutes at sweet spot. This is where the work pays off.
Halfway through the last block. Keep your form, keep it steady.
One minute to go. Give it everything you've got left, but keep it smooth.
That's all three blocks done. Ten minutes of cool-down now, getting easier as you go.

finish.text: Workout complete. Three times ten minutes at sweet spot. Well ridden.

power_high.text: Ease off a little, you're above the target.
A touch too hard. Back off slightly and save it for later.
Bring the power down a bit. Smooth and steady.

power_low.text: Push a little harder, you're under the target.
Lift the power a bit. You've got this.
A little more pressure on the pedals.

cadence_high.text: Your cadence is high. Shift to a bigger gear and slow the legs a little.
Spin a bit slower, in a bigger gear.

cadence_low.text: Your cadence is low. Shift to a lighter gear and spin a bit faster.
Pick up the cadence. Lighter gear, quicker legs.

on_target.text: Right on target. Nice and steady.
